headline: Decided to install cages over sprinkler heads; Shea High School roof, drainage, and classroom painting discussed.
summary: A recent nor'easter damaged the rubber roof membrane and detached a roof drain, letting water into the building. Updates also covered Baldwin warranty work, HVAC problems, and courtyard drainage. Earlier, the minutes of September 14, 2026 were approved on a 4-yes, 1-abstention vote.
decisions: Approved the September 14, 2026 meeting minutes, 4 yes and 1 abstention.
Decided to install cages to protect the sprinkler heads.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to Approve: Hersh Cristino Second: Mark Andrade Yea: Hersh Cristino, Mark Andrade, Joanne Bonollo, Matthew Wildenhain Abstain: Stephanie DeMaio Motion carries.
Mr. Wildenhain requested that sprinkler heads be protected; it was decided through discussion that cages for the sprinkler heads would be installed.
